page.layout: One page, title page. Top to bottom: title lines in large type (LEXICON, NOVUM, Chaldæo-Biblicum), the subtitle in italic and roman lines, the author's name, a woodcut engraving in the middle, then the imprint below a rule (ULTRAJECTI, and the printer's line with date).
page.notes: Woodcut engraving between the author's name and the imprint, not transcribed: a figure at left holding an open book, with a banner reading "VIVITURINGENI" (partly unclear) and a serpent; at right a figure in plumed headdress with a palm tree; a landscape with ruins and a sitting figure in the centre. A rule separates ULTRAJECTI from the printer's line. The Google "Digitized by" watermark at the lower right is not transcribed. The title words "Græci" and "Danie-" are read from the scan; the lower-case æ in "Chaldæo" and "Academiæ" is as printed.
